groups.saying_opens: قد ثبت حديث من يرفع يديه
كان مالك بن أنس يرى رفع اليدين
كان سفيان بن عيينة وعمر بن هارون

notes: Five separate isnads, each with its own saying (owner ruling 6): the Zuhri route, Ibn al-Mubarak's, Malik's, Ma'mar's, and Jarud's («سمعت الجارود»).
«بهذا الإسناد» is not at the opening, so nothing is inherited; it is kept as a final back_reference.
«وفي الباب عن عمر» and the list of scholars who follow a view are compiler's remarks, not chains; left out.
«قال يحيى» in the Ma'mar isnad is a different Yahya written in the chain; not merged with Yahya ibn Musa (rule 9).
